title: THE TRAP
set: The Phantom of the Picture Palace

floorplan.camera: ENTRANCE_END of the centre aisle at standing height, looking along the aisle toward SCREEN_END

anchors.SCREEN_END: far end of frame, huge glowing screen
anchors.LEFT_SEAT_BLOCK: bank of red velvet seats flanking the aisle on the camera-left side
anchors.RIGHT_SEAT_BLOCK: bank of red velvet seats flanking the aisle on the camera-right side
anchors.AISLE: straight carpeted strip running bottom-centre to screen

cast.action: stands IN THE AISLE facing the camera, caught mid-lunge inside the dropped bunting net: the mesh hangs over his raised arms and shoulders, its near edge at his waist and its far edge at his knees, his sleeves caught in the mesh, LEFT sleeve slipped back revealing a black rubber-hose four-fingered jointless hand
cast.gaze_target: akane (her seat, down the aisle toward camera)

cast.depth: near, end seat of the back row
cast.action: sits in the END SEAT OF THE BACK ROW, aisle carpet immediately to her right, row continuing to her left; legs crossed at knee, one hand in lap, other holding a nail file paused mid-stroke; heavy-lidded, almost bored
cast.gaze_target: phantom (watches it fall into the net, heavy-lidded and utterly calm)

cast.depth: foreground frame-left, on the aisle's left edge, feet braced against the back seat row
cast.action: hauls the net's draw rope down and back with both hands, body leaned into the pull; rope runs diagonally up and forward to the net's near-left corner

cast.depth: foreground frame-right, on the aisle's right edge
cast.action: holds the just-yanked release rope slack in both hands, weight thrown back, one foot stepped behind him, masked face turned toward the phantom

props.anchor: LEFT_SEAT_BLOCK: seat immediately to Akane's left, lid off, coil of old film strip spilling out (the bait)
props.description: a round metal film canister, lid off, a coil of old film strip spilling out

props.anchor: AISLE: from Lucy's hands diagonally up-forward to the net's near-left corner
props.description: a thick hemp draw-rope, taut from Lucy's hands up to the net's near-left corner

props.anchor: AISLE: slack in Wyatt's hands, running up through the right pulley block
props.description: a slack hemp release-rope from Wyatt's hands up through the right ceiling pulley block

props.anchor: AISLE: its four corners run on ropes up to the two ceiling pulley blocks, one pair at the aisle's left edge and one pair at its right
props.description: a rectangular knotted-rope net as wide as the aisle, woven with gold tinsel garlands and red ribbon; wide open mesh with large visible gaps
props.state: the net hangs in a U over the phantom; his raised arms and shoulders are inside it, the mesh pressing his sleeves to his body; the near edge is at his waist, the far edge at his knees; the net hangs free of his hands

props.anchor: AISLE: worn by the phantom, pale dust bursting at hem
props.description: the phantom's floor-length layered grey-white gauze robe, pale dust bursting at the hem

moment: The trap has sprung mid-action, everyone in motion. The phantom is caught mid-lunge inside the dropped net as it hangs around its raised arms. Lucy hauls the draw rope; Wyatt has yanked the release rope. Akane sits as bait, unbothered, filing her nails.
environment: raked rows of deep-red velvet seats with brass row-ends both sides of the carpeted centre aisle; two ceiling pulley blocks above the aisle edges with ropes to the net corners; bunting net of gold tinsel garlands, red ribbon and knotted rope; huge screen glowing soft white-gold at far end with abstract blurred light shapes of soft colour; projector beam cone through dust from behind camera; warm wall sconces; dropped popcorn tub in the aisle; paper bats and paper pumpkin garland on balcony rail, shapes only.
lighting: screen glow from the far end rims the phantom and falling net; projector beam shafts over the scene; warm sconce fill on the gang; dramatic cel contrast, net shadow striping the aisle.
colour: full, rich colour — red velvet, gold bunting, warm light; the phantom dusty grey-white at the centre.
negatives: all signage, tickets and screens are plain blank surfaces
clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout
the phantom stays a costume: the rubber-hose hand is a costume detail
Akane watches with heavy-lidded calm, her hands busy in her lap or at her sides
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck
